name: superset-agent-orchestrator
description: Local-first MCP server for durable orchestration of parallel coding agents through Superset

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:python && npm run schema:check
scripts.format: prettier --write '.github/**/*.yml' README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md docs/branch-protection.md eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check '.github/**/*.yml' README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md docs/branch-protection.md eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json
scripts.schema:check: npm run schema && git diff --exit-code -- config/mcp-tools.schema.json
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:race
